title: Surplus retaining structures.
officialText:
Where any owner maintains his or her ground either higher or lower than the legal
regulation prescribed in the Administrative Code, the surplus retaining structure that may be necessary to support such height or
provide for such excavation shall be made at the sole expense of such owner, and any additional thickness that may be required
shall be built on the land of such owner.
